notes:
## Bug fixes
- SmartSmooth no longer fails with "Shared threshold topology produced mixed-classification faces" in densely built areas at the edge of the calculation grid. A region that straddles a threshold, for example along a building's shadow edge, is now divided using the classification of each calculated point.
- Acoustic barriers are no longer interpolated across. Interpolated Raster, Acoustic Scalar Field and SmartSmooth treat each barrier as a thin wall, like a building, so the source side keeps its levels right up to the barrier and the shadow no longer leaks across it in a stepped edge.
